title: Sample fetch and zip assembly in the page (web/src/data, no server)
description:
In web/src: fetch each sample the manifest names through the existing data layer (catalog.ts, authAware client), report progress, build the `<Score> Project/` tree and zip it in the browser. Choose a small zip library (fflate is the likely pick; package.json change is the web session's call) or a hand-rolled store-only zip. Fail whole, never a partial zip; errors name the sample and the track.

Verification: a vitest or node test zips a two-sample score from fixtures and lists the entries; `npm run build` green.
